about: Files copied here byte for byte from another code tree. store-size.json stays in Trillion-X/trillion too: trillion's own store code (src/store-size.mjs, src/store-health.mjs, src/record-book.mjs) reads it, so trillion owns it, and this copy is what do-work/kept-runs.mjs reads instead of a path into another repository. Change the numbers in trillion and copy them here in the same change.
